artefact_file: test_data/evtx/TA0008-Lateral Movement/T1021.002-SMB Windows Admin Shares/ID5142- New file share created.evtx
scenario_prompt: Analyze these Windows event logs for signs of unauthorized file share creation or SMB-based lateral movement. Identify the shares involved, the account used, and the source of the activity. Use only evidence present in the data.

expected_findings.indicator: Event ID 5142: A new network share was created (hidden-share$)
expected_findings.explanation: A hidden file share named 'hidden-share$' was created, which is a technique used to establish covert file access during lateral movement.
The admmig account was used to create the share and access administrative shares, indicating a compromised administrative account.
The C$ administrative share and the newly created hidden share were accessed from IP 10.23.23.9, indicating remote lateral movement via SMB.

notes: Easy case: 4 events showing share creation (5142) and access (5145) with obvious hidden share name. Clear lateral movement (T1021.002) indicators with named account and source IP.
